title: Figures 3-4: Ragone Plot and SOHIO Electrolytic Capacitor Patent Drawing
description: Figure 3, 'Ragone Plot', is a log-log chart of energy density (Wh/kg) versus power density (W/kg) with shaded regions for fuel cells, conventional batteries, ultracapacitors and conventional capacitors, plus diagonal time lines for 10 hours, 1 hour, 1 second and 0.03 second. Figure 4, 'Electrolytic Capacitor as Designed and Patented by SOHIO', is a line drawing of a cell with conductors, porous graphite electrodes, a saturated Al2(SO4)3 solution and an ion-permeable membrane.
